jobs.title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior Mechanical Engineer – bouw mee aan de machines van morgen

**Tiel · 32–40 uur · vanaf €3.300 per maand · start per direct**

Je hebt een idee voor een machine en twee weken later staat er een geprint prototype op je bureau. Bij Olmia kan dat. Wij zoeken een jonge, ondernemende engineer die zelf nieuwe projecten uitdenkt en uitwerkt, als rechterhand van het management.

**Over Olmia**

Olmia Procestechniek in Tiel levert sinds 2004 pompen, compressoren, afsluiters, magneetventielen, pneumatiek en instrumentatie aan OEMs (machine- en apparaten bouwers). We zijn exclusieve dealer van Thomas (Gardner Denver) en voeren merken als Bürkert, Festo, Flowline. Er liggen meer dan 1.000 artikelen op voorraad.

Maar we doen meer dan leveren. We ontwerpen, bouwen en assembleren kleine tot middelgrote systemen voor OEM-klanten: van eerste schets en prototype tot kleine en middelgrote series. Voorbeelden zijn een 1-MCP-gasgenerator voor fruitbehandeling, een methanoldoseersysteem voor mobiele energievoorzieningen en een anti-legionella-doseerbox voor publieke omgevingen zoals ziekenhuizen. Onze stijl: no-nonsense, korte lijnen, praktische oplossingen. *Pump up your potential!*

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zet ideeën om in werkende hardware. Soms vraagt een klant om een nieuw systeem of een sub-assembly. Soms komen we zelf met een idee voor een nieuwe machine of een nieuw product. In beide gevallen ben jij degene die het concreet maakt.

* **Concepten uitwerken:** van klantvraag of eigen idee naar een eerste ontwerp. Je denkt mee over pompkeuze, flow, druk, medium en inbouw.
* **Tekenen in SolidWorks:** 3D-modellen en werktekeningen van apparaten, modules en behuizingen waarin een pomp of compressor zit.
* **Prototypen bouwen:** onderdelen printen op onze 3D-printer, testopstellingen bouwen, meten en verbeteren.
* **Samenwerken met partners:** je stuurt externe partijen aan, zoals een PCB-ontwerper, plaatwerker of CNC-bedrijf, en zorgt dat het geheel past.
* **Projecten trekken:** je houdt planning, kosten en voortgang bij en rapporteert direct aan het management.
* **Technische ondersteuning:** samen met de binnendienst pak je lastige technische aanvragen op en denk je mee met klanten.

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor en werkplaats in Tiel. Af en toe ga je mee naar een klant om een toepassing te bekijken.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent hungry. Je wacht niet tot iemand je een taak geeft, maar komt zelf met een voorstel en een eerste schets. Je vindt het leuk om van het idee tot het werkende prototype alles zelf te doen.

* Een afgeronde mbo-4- of hbo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica, Industrieel Product Ontwerpen of vergelijkbaar. Pas afgestudeerd is prima.
* Je kunt goed overweg met SolidWorks (of een vergelijkbaar 3D-CAD-pakket) en met 3D-printsoftware.
* Je bent technisch nieuwsgierig. Pompen, pneumatiek of elektronica vind je interessant, ook al weet je er nog niet alles van.
* Je neemt initiatief, zet door en houdt het overzicht als je meerdere dingen tegelijk doet.
* Je communiceert helder met collega's, klanten en leveranciers, in het Nederlands en in het Engels.
* Je hebt rijbewijs B.

**Pluspunten:** ervaring met prototyping of een eigen maakproject, basiskennis van elektronica of Arduino en ervaring met Office 365. Daarnaast zijn we AI-first, dat betekent slim werken waar het kan met o.a. Claude en chatGPT.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij ons krijg je de kans om een leidende rol te pakken en door te groeien. Hoe snel dat gaat, bepaal je grotendeels zelf.

* Echte verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één: jouw ontwerpen worden gebouwd en verkocht.
* Direct contact met het management en korte lijnen, zonder lagen ertussen.
* Een salaris vanaf €3.300 bruto per maand (bij 40 uur), afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring.
* 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag.
* Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en ondernemerschap, en een eigen 3D-printer om ze uit te proberen.
* Een klein, hecht team en een altijd gezellige vrijdagmiddagborrel!

Salaris: Vanaf €3.300,00 per maand

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**This is how you make impact as a Design Engineer**
----------------------------------------------------

As a Design Engineer at Neways in Nijmegen, you play a key role in developing high-quality technical solutions for our customers. You translate customer requirements and specifications into smart, manufacturable designs that are not only functional but can also be produced efficiently and reliably. Through your technical expertise and innovative mindset, you directly contribute to the development of new products, tooling, and production technologies within a high-tech manufacturing environment.

You work closely with customers, Project Leaders, Process Engineers, and suppliers to transform concepts into successful products. Using advanced design tools and simulation software, you assess the technical feasibility of designs and optimize performance, quality, and cost.

**This is what we offer**
-------------------------

A challenging role as a Design Engineer in a dynamic high-tech environment located at the Noviotech Campus, featuring excellent facilities and easy accessibility. This position gives you the opportunity to combine technology, innovation, and manufacturing while making a visible contribution to the development of complex high-tech products.

You will join an organization that highly values personal interaction and collaboration. We are committed to your continuous development and therefore offer plenty of opportunities for personal growth, learning, and initiative. You will work in a diverse and engaged team with an open, supportive, and informal working atmosphere.

In addition, you will have opportunities for both local and international travel to represent your role as a Design Engineer and help ensure high-quality process compliance across our divisions.

You can also count on:

* A competitive salary based on your skills and experience.
* 27 vacation days, supplemented by 13 additional ADV (reduction of working hours) days.
* An attractive bicycle leasing scheme.
* A solid pension plan, holiday allowance, and travel expense reimbursement.
* A healthy and safe working environment.
* Opportunities for personal and professional development through training and education.
* The chance to work with advanced technologies and innovative products in a high-tech manufacturing environment.

**This is what you bring to the team**
--------------------------------------

* Completed HBO or WO degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* Affinity with electronics and electronic systems within a high-tech manufacturing environment.
* Affinity with the design, evaluation, and optimization of PCB (Printed Circuit Board) layouts.
* Experience with CAD software such as Solid Edge and/or AutoCAD.
* Knowledge of simulation software, preferably ANSYS, for mechanical and thermal analyses.
* Experience in the development of technical products, tooling, and manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of materials, tooling, production technologies, and Design for Manufacturing (DfM) principles.
* Experience conducting feasibility studies, tolerance analyses, and FMEAs.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* An analytical and structured approach, with a keen eye for detail.
* Good command of both Dutch and English, written and spoken.

**Your daily responsibilities include**
---------------------------------------

* Translating customer requirements and specifications into innovative and manufacturable technical designs.
* Defining functional and technical specifications for mechanical modules in close collaboration with customers.
* Developing and creating 3D models, manufacturing drawings, and technical documentation.
* Designing packages, leadframes, and tooling solutions.
* Conducting feasibility studies and simulations to support technical decision-making.
* Setting up, analyzing, and reporting on Design of Experiments (DOE).
* Creating and maintaining Design FMEAs.
* Compiling and managing Bills of Materials (BOMs) in accordance with customer, safety, and environmental requirements.
* Performing cost-benefit analyses for materials and design solutions.
* Developing proposals for product and process improvements.
* Presenting and reporting design results and technical findings in English.
* Participating in project and engineering meetings and contributing to technical decision-making.
* Supporting Process Engineers during the development and industrialization phases.
* Providing metrology and measurement support to Process Engineers and Production Operators.
* Collaborating with suppliers regarding materials, tooling, and technical solutions.
* Ensuring accurate and complete design documentation, including the rationale behind design decisions.

Keiron Technologies is a deep-tech company on the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven. You work in a multidisciplinary team following the V-model, and play a leading role in a fast-moving field.

You will:

* Own system and module design, oversee planning and execution together with the System Architect and Project Manager, and coach junior mechanical engineers
* Drive the mechanical design from concept to detailed engineering, focusing on precision, reliability and scalability
* Work closely with Software, Electrical and Research teams and with co-developers for smooth system integration
* Improve existing systems on efficiency, cost and manufacturability, based on the roadmap and on customer and field feedback
* Test and validate concepts and prototypes in a pragmatic way to get early insights
* Make sure engineering documentation and specifications are accurate and of high quality

**Your profile**
----------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar
* 10+ years of experience in mechanical development, of which at least 3 years in a senior (leading or coordinating) role
* Proven track record in developing complex mechanical systems, preferably in printing, high-precision or advanced equipment
* Proficiency with SolidWorks (PDM, 3D modeling, simulation and detailed 2D drawings)
* Strong leadership, organizational and decision-making skills, and excellent communication skills
* A plus: familiarity with laser-based technologies, automation and control systems, and relevant industry standards

Keiron offers a competitive salary, access to cutting-edge technology and research facilities, and room for professional development and career growth.

If you are a senior mechanical designer who wants to set the technical direction for printing equipment built on LIFT technology, please send your resume and cover letter to jobs@keirontechnologies.com.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Surface Treatment
jobs.description:
**Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.**

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

**The vacancy: Manufacturing Engineer - Materials & Processes**
---------------------------------------------------------------

We are looking to strengthen the Manufacturing Engineering team at Fokker Landing Gear, located in Papendrecht, and for this reason, we are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer – Materials & Processes for the Surface Treatment team.
  
As a Manufacturing Engineer at our multi-technology manufacturing campus in Papendrecht, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficient and seamless production of landing gear components by focusing on the processes of honing, grinding, polishing and benchwork operations. Your contributions will directly support the delivery of unique projects that prioritize the safety of everyone who relies on our products in flight.

**Fokker Landing Gear**
-----------------------

Fokker Landing Gear, part of GKN Fokker, is a recognized specialist in landing gear and related systems. We focus on the design and development, production and assembly of complete landing gears, as well as the repair and reassembly of systems already in use. In doing so, we work on the most famous aircraft and helicopters; think of the Apache combat helicopter, the F-35 Lightning II (JSF), the Bombardier Dash 8 Q400 and the multipurpose NH90 maritime combat helicopter.

**About this position**
-----------------------

At the forefront of Europe’s photonics innovation, TNO is building a state-of-the-art pilot line for Indium Phosphide (InP) photonic chips at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven. As part of the EU-funded PIXEurope program, this pilot line will enable the transition from groundbreaking research to large-scale industrial manufacturing, making advanced photonic technologies faster, more reliable, and widely accessible.
  
To help realize this ambitious step, we are looking for a Mask Design Engineer. In this role, you will operate at the interface of process technology and end-user needs, translating photonic chip designs into mask layouts that can be fabricated in the pilot line. With your technical expertise in mask layout generation, tape-out execution, design rule checking, and scripting, you will ensure that designs are accurately translated into reliable and manufacturable mask sets.

**What will be your role?**
---------------------------

As Mask Design Engineer, you will be part of the vertical integration team, supporting the Process Architect and Process Engineers in developing the mask designs and layouts required for Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) manufacturing. You will work closely with external end users to translate their designs into mask layouts suitable for fabrication within the pilot line.
  
You will be responsible for creating the mask layouts needed to execute all lithography steps throughout the PIC fabrication flow. This includes developing test masks, process control modules (PCMs), basic building block layouts, and complete mask assemblies. A thorough understanding of the overall fabrication process, including the details of individual process steps, is essential to translate building block designs into complete sets of mask layouts. You will also perform Design Rule Checking (DRC) on mask designs developed by other designers to ensure compliance with manufacturing requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

* Creating and preparing mask layouts for all lithography steps within the photonic integrated circuit fabrication flow.
* Translating building block designs and external end-user designs into complete, manufacturable mask layouts based on the requirements of the pilot line.
* Performing full tape-out activities, including super-cell creation, PCM cell generation, layer post-processing, GDS validation, and mask ordering.
* Conducting Design Rule Checks (DRC) on mask designs created internally and externally, identifying and resolving potential manufacturing rule violations.
* Developing supporting tools for the tape-out process and for users working with the pilot line's mask sets.
* Coordinating with PDK and IT engineers on design environments, software tooling, system access, and workflow-related topics.

**What we expect from you**

You are a technically skilled Mask Design Engineer with a strong interest in semiconductor and photonic chip manufacturing. You combine technical expertise in layout design and scripting with a structured, analytical approach and a strong focus on quality. You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment, understand the importance of accuracy in mask preparation, and proactively identify opportunities to improve and automate existing workflows. You are eager to learn new methods, tools, and industry best practices and are motivated to contribute to the development of Europe's photonic chip manufacturing capabilities.

You also bring the following qualifications:

* An MSc or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Photonics, or a related technical field.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Ruby for scripting, automation, and layout processing.
* Familiarity with GDS-II file formats and layout design tools such as KLayout, Nazca, or similar software.
* Understanding of Design Rule Checking (DRC) concepts and layer-based processing.
* A strong quality mindset, with excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to technical work.
* Understanding of Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) is a strong advantage.
* Experience in a semiconductor or photonic foundry or R&D environment is considered a plus.
* Familiarity with EDA tools such as Synopsys OptoDesigner, Ansys Lumerical, or similar software is an advantage.

TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect:

**What to Expect**

The Senior Process Engineer, Battery Pack Remanufacturing, will lead the development, implementation and optimization of high-volume processes that return used battery packs to service. The role owns the full remanufacturing value stream: core receipt and grading, high-voltage discharge and disassembly, diagnostics, module and component repair or replacement, reassembly, end-of-line validation and final release.

Remanufacturing brings challenges that new-build production does not, including wide variation in core condition, varied component histories and dependence on reverse supply chains. The Senior Process Engineer will design robust, safe and cost-effective processes that perform reliably across this variation while supporting a rapid volume ramp. Acting as a technical leader, the incumbent will partner with Battery Engineering, Quality, Service, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Operations to maximize recovery yield, reduce cost per pack and feed remanufacturing insights into future pack designs.

 **What You'll Do**

* Process Development and Capacity Scaling: Lead the design and continuous improvement of disassembly, repair, reassembly and test operations using Lean Manufacturing principles. Drive line balancing, constraint analysis, capital equipment selection and automation of repetitive or hazardous tasks. Manage changes through the Production Change Approval process.
* High-Voltage Safety and Regulatory Compliance: In partnership with EHS, Logistics and Regulatory, establish and enforce procedures for the safe handling, discharge, isolation, storage and transport of high-voltage and damaged battery packs. This includes thermal event prevention, quarantine, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and compliance with hazardous materials and recycling requirements.
